intro.h2: House painting in Wagoner, OK, with patience built in
paragraphs: R&H Solutions LLC is a painting company on NE 3rd Street in Wagoner, OK, led by Henry with Diego and the rest of the crew. We handle house painting inside and out, from siding and scalloped trim to bedrooms, front doors and privacy fences. Customers call us the best family owned company in Oklahoma.

Attention to detail is the topic that comes up most in our Google reviews. Color is the other. Henry gives his opinion when you ask for it and never pressures you. When one homeowner decided she did not like her bedroom color after the first coat, we repainted it, and Diego brought back a sample that turned out to be perfect.

items.name: Exterior house painting
items.blurb: Siding, trim, porch posts and garage doors, painted to make an older home look cared for again. One customer says Henry, Diego and the team restored her house and made it like new. The porch here got fresh olive siding with cream trim on its scalloped gable and turned columns.

image.alt: Front porch with freshly painted olive siding, cream scalloped gable trim and turned cream columns

items.name: Interior painting
items.blurb: Bedrooms, living rooms and tall vaulted walls, finished with clean edges and tidy cleanup. One homeowner says the house finally feels like home and plans to have us back for other rooms. If a color looks wrong once it is on the wall, tell us and we will work it out with you.

image.alt: Vaulted living room with freshly painted warm white walls, a stone fireplace and a loft railing

items.name: Doors and trim
items.blurb: A painted front door changes the whole entry. This one now wears a deep teal with a smooth finish on every panel and around the window grid. Tell us which doors or trim pieces need fresh color, and we will plan them to suit the rest of the house.

image.alt: Front door painted deep teal with a six-pane window, shown open beside a white louvered closet door

items.name: Fence staining
items.blurb: Weathered privacy fences get a fresh coat of stain to protect the wood and tidy up the yard. Henry was patient with one customer who had a hard time choosing a fence stain color, and she says the crew was efficient, on time and tidy.

Henry leads the business and the crew, and Diego is a familiar face on our jobs, known for listening and suggesting colors that work. Our customers hire us to restore tired houses, paint bedrooms and living areas, and stain fences, and many say they will have us back for more rooms. process.h2: How a painting job with us works

steps.title: Call us
steps.text: Call (918) 304-1898, Monday to Saturday between 6 AM and 7 PM, and tell us which rooms or surfaces need paint.

steps.title: Estimate visit
steps.text: Henry walks the house with you and gives an estimate. Customers mention our estimate process in their reviews.

steps.title: Choose colors together
steps.text: Take your time picking colors. We share our opinion when asked and can bring samples to help you decide.

steps.title: Paint and check in
steps.text: The crew paints with care and checks in as coats go on, so you can speak up if a color is not right.

steps.title: Walk-through
steps.text: We walk the finished rooms or exterior with you and leave the house clean when we go.

items.name: Leah S.
items.text:
Henry and his team did a fantastic job on staining my privacy fence and with the interior painting of my home. Besides their efficiency they were always on time, tidy and kind. I especially appreciate how patient Henry was with me when I had a hard time deciding on the fence stain color and the interior painting. He never pressured me into picking a color but thoughtfully gave his opinion when asked as he wanted to make sure I was going to be happy with what I chose. In fact, when I decided I didn’t like the paint color I chose for my bedroom, after they had painted the first coat, he was more than happy to repaint it.  Thankfully Diego, I hope I remembered that correctly, listened and gave his opinion on what he thought might work. He came back with a sample color that he picked out based on our conversations and it was perfect!!!
I wouldn’t hesitate to use Henry and his team again.

items.name: Lauren R.
items.text: Henry, Diego, and the rest of the team who worked on my house were amazing in every way. They went above and beyond in their professionalism to restore my house and make it like new. Henry is very knowledgeable about his craft and made sure every detail was executed to perfection. I am honored to have worked with them throughout the transformation process of my home. I look forward to working with them again on future projects. These guys are the real deal!

items.name: Melissa M.
items.text: These guys are amazing! The house actually feels like home now. Thank you Henry and your fantastic crew! I will definitely be having them back to tackle other rooms.

service_area.h2: House painting in Wagoner, OK, and nearby
service_area.text: R&H Solutions LLC is based at 309 NE 3rd St in Wagoner, OK 74467, and paints homes in and around Wagoner. If you live outside town and want to know whether we can take your job, call (918) 304-1898 and tell us where you are and what needs painting. We pick up the phone Monday through Saturday from 6 AM to 7 PM.

items.a: We paint house exteriors, including siding, trim, porch posts and garage doors, and interiors such as bedrooms and living rooms. We also paint front doors and stain privacy fences. Our photos show a full exterior repaint in olive and cream and a front door in deep teal.

items.q: Can you help me choose colors?
items.a: Yes. Henry is patient and never pushes a color on you, but he will give his opinion when you ask. One customer struggled to pick both a fence stain and interior colors, and Diego later brought back a sample color based on their conversations that turned out perfect.

items.q: What if I do not like the color once it is on the wall?
items.a: Tell us early. One homeowner decided she did not like her bedroom color after the first coat, and Henry was more than happy to repaint it. That is why we check in with you as the first coats go on, before the job is finished.

Yes. Henry comes out to look at the job and gives you an estimate before work starts. The estimate process is one of the topics customers mention in our Google reviews, and one says she is beyond satisfied with the pricing, finished product and customer service.

We are open Monday through Saturday from 6 AM to 7 PM and closed on Sunday. Call (918) 304-1898 or email contact.rnhsolutions@yahoo.com to set up a time to look at your house. Early risers are welcome: our day starts at 6 AM.
